long_biography.plain_text:
The opportunity Hervé Giaoui saw in France’s Caribbean territories was to bring organised home retail to markets with limited choice. After studying hotel management in Nice, he sold Japanese hi-fi equipment door to door, then moved into furniture and secured a But franchise. CAFOM grew from that shift, building its own buying operation and a network of stores across overseas territories.

Giaoui extended the model beyond physical shops by co-founding Vente-unique.com, which sells furniture online across Europe. He also took CAFOM into established household names, including the Habitat brand, while retaining an active role in group management. A sizeable stake held through his investment company keeps his interests closely tied to the business he built.
long_biography.html:
The opportunity Hervé Giaoui saw in France’s Caribbean territories was to bring organised home retail to markets with limited choice. After studying hotel management in Nice, he sold Japanese hi-fi equipment door to door, then moved into furniture and secured a But franchise. CAFOM grew from that shift, building its own buying operation and a network of stores across overseas territories.

Giaoui extended the model beyond physical shops by co-founding Vente-unique.com, which sells furniture online across Europe. He also took CAFOM into established household names, including the Habitat brand, while retaining an active role in group management. A sizeable stake held through his investment company keeps his interests closely tied to the business he built.
